versions.changelog:
- Removed the file skill-card.md.
- Updated the large model used from u1-insuremed to u2-med in the API configuration section.
- No changes to skill logic or user workflow.

- Initial release with academic material generation for medical affairs in the pharmaceutical sector
- Supports structured input (topic, material type, audience, key messages, evidence, references)
- Outputs academic drafts with references, following Scientific Writing skill’s scientific draft generation approach
- Accepts multiple input formats including JSON, CSV/XLSX, TXT/MD, PDF, DOC/DOCX, and image OCR
- Requires internal medical LLM API (u1-insuremed) via OpenClaw with mandatory appkey authentication
- Only generates academic drafts; does not provide clinical, regulatory, or promotional content
